select sm.study_id, sm.member_id, sm.joined_at, sm.member_status, m.nickname, m.gender,
case when sm.member_id = s.leader_id then true else false end as leader
from study_member sm
join member m on sm.member_id = m.member_id
join study s on sm.study_id = s.study_id
where sm.study_id = #{studyId} and sm.member_status = 'ACTIVE'
order by sm.joined_at asc
